moved.sentence: Use Jetpack Glance with Compose-style APIs for home screen widgets.

moved.sentence: Support small, medium, and large widget families.

moved.sentence: For real-time status, use Live Activities with `ActivityKit` and the Dynamic Island on supported devices.

moved.sentence: Show only the most important information — widgets are not miniature apps

moved.sentence: Support multiple widget sizes when the platform offers them

moved.sentence: Support periodic background sync via service workers for data freshness.

moved.sentence: Explore experimental Widget API proposals where available.
